name: bf-payroll
description: Burkina Faso payroll tax reference for the 2026 tax year, covering employer IUTS salary withholding and the separate employer-funded TPA. Use for monthly salary bands, current housing, function and transport exemptions, pension and professional-expense deductions, benefits in kind, family reductions, monthly remittance and the small-payment half-year option. It explains the statutory payroll records and annual statements, with two executable cases including a remittance-frequency decision. The Guide keeps CNSS and universal health contributions separate and does not certify their rates, the minimum wage or a complete employment-cost calculation. Current electronic forms, boxes and filing acknowledgements still require source confirmation.
